verses.text: For, behold, the wicked tread the bow; they make ready their arrow upon the string, to shoot in the darkness at those upright in heart.

verses.text: If the foundations are thrown down, the righteous—what can he do?”

verses.text: YHWH [is] in His holy temple; YHWH—in the heavens [is] His throne. His eyes are watching, His eyelids examine the sons of man.

verses.text: YHWH tests the righteous, and His soul hates the wicked one and the lover of violence.

verses.text: May He rain [down] coals upon the wicked, fire and brimstone; and a burning wind [is] the portion of their cup.

verses.text: For YHWH [is] righteous; He loves righteousness; the upright one will see His face.
